anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.text:
Which behavior should the workspace-switch filter policy apply when the user changes workspace in the report view?
A) clear all filters - every switch starts the report unfiltered
B) preserve all active filters - the current filters carry into the new workspace unchanged
C) restore each workspace's last filters - each workspace reopens with the filters it had when the user last left it
Recommendation: B - the workspace-change handler in ui/report-view.ts already keeps active filters, so B changes no existing behavior and needs no stored filters per workspace.
